latest_release.name: v3.13.0
latest_release.body: ## Highlights - **Contribution limits.** Open a limit to see what counts toward it, and leave out any you don't want counted. **Repeats every year** shows the coming years for you to add, and one dialog edits everything. (#1841, #2525, #2593) - **Match transfers.** Find transfers whose two sides came in separately and link them in bulk, from the Health Center or, on desktop, Activities → **Add Activities**. **Make it a transfer...** turns one deposit or withdrawal into a transfer. (#2523, #2349) - **Past periods.** The dashboard and Insights → Spending get **Previous period** and **Next period** arrows, and the calendar picker gets **Month** and **Year** tabs. Spending adds a **1W** range and **Compare to prior period**. (#2554) - **Savings goals in Budgets.** Give a savings category a **Savings goal**. It fills as you move money to savings each month. (#2249) - **Dividends and interest before tax.** Enter the **Amount before tax** and **Withholding tax** from your statement, and the app works out the **Received amount**, or the other way round. (#2493) - **Merge spending categories.** Delete a category you've used by merging it into another. Its transactions, splits, rules and budget amounts move with it. (#2604) - **Export all your data.** Settings → **Backup & export** → **Data export** saves everything you've entered as one ZIP or JSON file. (#2572) - **Rebuilt phone forms.** **Add expense** and **Add income** start with the amount, pickers open inside the form, and forms stay above the keyboard. (#2485) - **Ask the assistant about your spending.** The in-app assistant can now read your Spending reports, budgets, transactions and events, and shows each answer as a card. (#2633) - **AI agents can set up your data.** Over MCP, an agent can add accounts, holdings, alternative assets and liabilities with their values, and check and fix market data. It previews new records before saving, and Health Center issues name what they affect. (#2573, #2575, #2578, #2566, #2568, #2569, #2570, #2576, #2563) ## Upgrading - The first launch recalculates your holdings once, but snapshots you entered yourself don't change. (#2542) - **Synced devices:** update all of them before you make a limit repeat or leave a contribution out of one. A device still on 3.12 ignores both. (#1841, #2525) - **Moved:** you now pick a limit's accounts in its **Edit** dialog. **Last month** is gone: use **Previous period** or **Month**. (#2593, #2554) - **Numbers that may change:** Income's **Monthly Average** now counts the same months in every period, and a transfer between two credit cards or loans no longer counts as **Saved**. (#2591, #2579) - **Exchange rates to check:** manual rates in a quote unit such as GBp still aren't used, so enter the main currency's rate instead. A crypto pair such as BTC/USD added before this update needs its symbol changed to `BTC-USD`. (#2583, #2560) - **Alternative assets in another currency** added before this update still have no exchange rate. If no account uses that currency, add the rate in Settings → General → Exchange rates. (#2577) - **AI agent access:** for the new write tools, add **Accounts — write** or **Holdings — write** in Settings → AI agent access and reconnect the agent. **Holdings & value (read)** now also reads asset setup, prices and exchange rates, and **Market data — write** can also refresh prices and change an asset's setup. (#2573, #2575, #2578, #2568, #2569, #2570, #2576) - **In-app assistant:** if a provider's **Data access** is still on its default, the assistant can now read your Spending data and send it to that provider.
